M2099 must decide whether measured-execution command design is admitted
M2099 must not run reset rollout measured execution or ranking
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken measured runner validation
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether metadata-compatible artifacts are clean enough for measured-execution command design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: metadata compatibility result audit only; no rollout driver performance ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2098 validation failures are nonzero
stop if audit would run reset or rollout
stop if audit would weaken measured runner validation
fallback_plan: route to measured-execution command design if M2098 artifact is clean
route to runner adapter design if compatibility validation remains blocked
route to materialization redesign if required metadata is not derivable

allowed_updates: M2099 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured-execution command design or compatibility fallback

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2099 audits metadata compatibility and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2099.

no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
